generalization to white wine other regions producers batches or future production
clinical regulatory or production deployment readiness

sampling_and_bias_register.basis: The UCI card describes separate wine samples and does not identify temporal spatial grouped or repeated-measure keys.
sampling_and_bias_register.unresolved_limit: UCI does not provide wine-brand grape-type batch taster or producer identifiers, so row independence cannot be proven or group-aware splitting reconstructed.
sampling_and_bias_register.ordinal_target_limit: quality is an ordered sensory score; UCI explicitly permits regression, but RMSE imposes numeric distance on that ordinal score.
sampling_and_bias_register.selection_bias_control: dataset models metrics seeds folds threshold and verdict were fixed before dataset download and before observing model results
sampling_and_bias_register.multiple_comparison_scope: one candidate versus one baseline on one target and one primary metric
